chapter: Sidemen, the Hampton years, race and money
title: Cover versions: Goodbye Pork Pie Hat, Jeff Beck and Woody Herman
summary: Few artists have recorded his songs; Beck's platinum album includes Pork Pie Hat.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Have you had a lot of cover records? I mean, I know that you had the famous one of Goodbye Porkpie Hat," which was on a million album seller or something like that. But I know that -- I'm just trying to think of -- have you had many other people record your songs?
No. Only the Porkpie Hat."
(Inaudible.) "Tijuana Table Dance."
Yeah, and Better Get It In Your Soul."
I think Woody did that.
That's right.
My theory is that your pieces are very difficult.
"Woody did some other things too - No room"
(Inaudible.) (Sings.)
What's the name of it again?
I played it with a ten-piece band, at the Vanguard. You must have heard it.
It's from the other album, then. Didn't you make two albums with that band?
Yeah. We did that one, too. Jack Hammer -- Bob Hammer.
Bob Hammer, yeah.
He wrote some of it.
Yeah, I remember your saying --
And I think Woody Herman is doing "Duke's Choice" now.
Which one?
"Duke's Choice."
"Duke's Choice?"
I was told someone -- he told me this trombone player (inaudible) wrote an arrangement on it.
What's "Duke's Choice" from?
(Inaudible), Atlantic. He wrote the arrangement on it. Not Duke's Choice, -- You heard it; it's the one with the singing on it. You
Oh, yes, of course.
"ELLINGTON'S Duke's Sound of Love."
"Duke's Sound of Love," yeah. That's a nice song. That's right. Were you surprised to find out that Jeff Beck had done "Porkpie Hat" on that album that he'd done?
Jeff Beck, that's the one that sold, isn't it?
That's the one that sold all those millions of copies. I guess that album went platinum.
Yeah.
That's a nice annuity for your old age there, Charles.
Yes.
You'll be making a lot of money from that for a long time.
Is Jeff Beck a guitar player?
